caveats: Region grid is 60x60 cells (lat 64.52-65.70, lon 21.98-23.16); 314 of 3600 cells are land or have non-finite SST on at least one target day and are set to 0 in mhw. Baseline windows used 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 beyond the 1992-2002 baseline. The first regional event starts on the first day of the target period, as analysis is restricted to 2016-06-01..2016-08-31 by design.
